integrity: The proof exposes all edges outside one triangle, classifies the resulting connectivity of its three vertices, and computes the exact rank reduction under the eight possible triangle-edge states. The component formula is then combined with the elementary edge-count covariance to obtain the cycle-rank formula. Exact rational enumeration independently replays the finite identities.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite identity assumes independent bond percolation.
The sparse asymptotic is proved only for fixed subcritical edge parameter c in (0,1).

Older random-graph literature on joint graph statistics may contain an implicit equivalent formula, although the closest inspected bridge and subgraph-count sources do not state the three-point connectivity identity.
title: Three-point connectivity exactly controls component–triangle covariance
